title: Token Strike
tagline: Web3 shooter where your firepower grows with real token deposits.
description: Token Strike is a Web3-powered arcade shooter where players convert real crypto tokens into in-game power. Every deposit generates bullets and damage based on live token prices, creating a unique connection between gameplay and on-chain value. Players fight through pixel-style battles using characters whose strength reflects their actual token holdings. With real-time price feeds, dynamic stats, and a simple reward-driven loop, Token Strike blends crypto strategy with fast, fun, retro gameplay. It’s designed to be accessible, addictive, and powered entirely by trustless smart contracts.
how_its_made:
Token Strike is a semi–on-chain arcade game where Solidity smart contracts power a TypeScript + Phaser front end. The core game contract is deployed on World Chain and uses Pyth’s on-chain price feeds to fetch real-time prices for WLD, WETH, and WBTC. These live feeds update gameplay logic dynamically like player bullets and damage scale based on the USD value of deposited tokens, creating a game loop that reacts to real market conditions.

The front end is built using Vite + TypeScript, and the game world itself is constructed with Phaser, which handles player movement, collisions, sprite animations, and all pixel-art rendering.

Wallet connection, deposits, and withdrawals are powered by Wagmi and Reown AppKit, ensuring smooth onboarding and instant contract interaction.

Token Strike also ships as a World App Mini-App, enabling users to play directly inside the World App environment.
